description: Implementation of the ''National Mission of the Nation Togethe'' Programme for eradicating Dangerous Drugs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The spread of dangerous drugs has become a national menace in this country and it has also been observed that many crimes are centered around this drug trafficking. It has been identified that the above menace should be eradicated through a national-level programme with national-level political leadership, an efficient decision-making mechanism and broad public participation. Accordingly, a programme called “National Mission of the Nation Together” has been planned to be implemented to achieve the said national objective. Under this programme, it is expected to create awareness among the society on this menace through an extensive publicity process, to break the network associated with drug trafficking, empower rehabilitation opportunities and provide opportunities for those who wish to quit. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to initiate the 'National Mission of the Nation Together” as an urgent and expeditious national programme and to establish a National Steering Committee for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.
